hypothesis: Explicit claim-level applicability and exception referent checks reduce observed scope errors without losing supported answers.
changed_variable: System prompt only; frozen baseline prompt unchanged.

cases.question: I sell on a domestic installment plan. A customer says the first installment was fraud and my acquirer cites Mastercard reason code 4837. How does the guide say the issuer must handle later installments?
cases.semantic_acceptance: Keep first-4837/later-4850 distinction. Do not apply Participating Countries deadlines/reference/docs without established region; omit unasked specialized advice.

cases.question: I already refunded a customer before my acquirer answered the chargeback. Does that refund end the dispute under Mastercard's rules, and what counts as a refund?
cases.semantic_acceptance: Keep supported general refund definition/documentation/exception branches. Do not generalize extra fines/fees from specialized reason-code sections; scope uncertainty must constrain claims, not just appear at end.

cases.question: A cardholder says they never authorized a purchase at my shop. Before the issuer can file a Mastercard chargeback for 'No Cardholder Authorization', what conditions does the issuer have to meet?
cases.semantic_acceptance: Keep issuer complaint/documentation/fraud reporting conditions. Do not make Stand-in listing exceptions waive account closure or host blocking; do not invent missing regional exception conditions.

cases.question: Fictional scenario: a diner says they were charged twice for one meal, and the notice cites Visa Condition 12.6.1, Duplicate Processing. What exactly is the cardholder claiming?
cases.semantic_acceptance: Preserve same credential/date/amount duplicate criterion; no unnecessary clarification.

cases.question: I use Adyen. How long do I have to upload Visa Allocation defense documents for locally processed US payments with disputes opened on 2 June 2025 and 5 August 2025, and a Germany-processed payment with a dispute opened on 5 August 2025? Can I add documents later?
cases.semantic_acceptance: Preserve June US 18/August locally processed US 9/August Germany 18-day answers and no later updates; no unnecessary clarification.

cases.question: Fictional example: an imaginary seller shipped a physical parcel abroad and the buyer claims it never arrived. What proof of delivery does PayPal UK Seller Protection expect, and does the choice of carrier matter?
cases.semantic_acceptance: Preserve physical delivery evidence and carrier/correct-address requirements; no unnecessary clarification.

generation_contract.baseline_comparison: Saved historical outputs; not a contemporaneous randomized comparison; hosted weights may differ.
generation_contract.protocol_correction: Before any calls: 0.2 draft corrected to provider default to match frozen Claude baseline.

promotion_gate.targets: All 3 citation-valid; faithfulness/applicability 2 and correctness at least 2 under existing rubric; requested completeness must not regress.
promotion_gate.controls: All 3 citation-valid; correctness/faithfulness/question completeness 2; no unjustified abstention.
promotion_gate.review: Every clause checked against scoped passage and quoted extract; record all failures. Codex assistance cannot be described as independent human validation.
promotion_gate.decision: Passing six selected development cases only supports a candidate; do not claim general robustness or silently replace baseline.
promotion_gate.failed_gate: Do not promote. Retain results and diagnose; no automatic retries.

excluded: No retrieval/context/gold/validator/pricing changes; no holdout access; no original failure repair.
